answer: Admission runs through CatchGate, a verifier checking a vessel quota certificate and its monitoring terminal serial against the landing register, refusing any quota serial or terminal bound to another hull. The penalty trigger is a duplicated quota serial or two boats landing from one terminal, which voids both permits and forfeits the bond. A permit costs 2400 dollars, a sealed terminal 900, an observer day 700, so N fakes cost N times 4000 dollars plus N observer days. A sable coat bought at the harbor cannot hide a quota fished twice, and a glacier fed fjord records every landing.
